main.description: An RSS or Atom feed the author follows or publishes. Minimum viable shape: a URL plus a display title. Optional fields support importer pipelines (destination NSID, poller bookkeeping) but are not required — most consumers just want the link to render on a personal site.

url.description: The URL of the RSS or Atom feed.

title.description: Human-readable display name for this feed.

description.description: Optional short description of the feed.

siteUrl.description: Optional URL of the human-readable home page that publishes this feed (e.g. the blog or podcast homepage).

destination.description: Optional NSID of the target lexicon for imported entries (used by importer pipelines, e.g. social.crate.content). Leave unset for plain feed links you just want to reference.

active.description: Whether an importer should actively fetch this feed. Defaults to false so adding a feed link doesn't accidentally enable polling.

lastPolledAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful poll (importer bookkeeping).

lastEntryGuid.description: GUID of the last imported entry, used by importers for deduplication.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this feed record was created.
